topic_title: Integrating Remote Sensing and in-situ observations of Biodiversity, towards a fully interoperable observation and data framework
work_programme_part: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, Part 9 - Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture and Environment (Cluster 6)
field_status_basis: Every field marked Confirmed traces to a named span of the Part 9 work programme PDF, recorded in docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/call_extracts/HORIZON-CL6-2027-01-BIODIV-01.json and re-checked against the page text by tests/test_tier2b_biodiv_intake.py. The spans sit on six pages, not four: the topic entry is on pages 73 to 76, the call timetable, destination heading and deadline model are on page 34, and the indicative number of projects comes from the 2027 budget table on page 35. No field is marked Confirmed on programme knowledge (CLAUDE.md §10.6), and none is marked Confirmed on the portal record alone.

project_duration.note: Tier 2B sets no duration for this topic. Pages 73 to 76 of the work programme carry no duration condition, and the portal record carries none. Duration is an operator choice. The concept ticket proposes a value and records the operator's decision; until then project_duration_months is absent rather than assumed (CLAUDE.md §13.3). runner/dependency_normalizer.py reads project_duration_months, so Phase 3 or 4 fails closed on its absence. That failure is the correct output, not a defect.

budget_route.phase_7_route: External Lump Sum Budget Planner. The repository prepares a request from docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/request_templates/, the operator runs the planner, and the response is validated in received/ and validation/ before gate_09 can pass (CLAUDE.md §8.1, §8.2, §8.4).
budget_route.tier_2b_basis: The topic overrides General Annex G: eligible costs take the form of a lump sum (work programme page 73, continuing on page 74).
budget_route.tier_2a_basis: docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/extracted/instrument_registry.json records budget_regime lump_sum for RIA. The two tiers agree, so no §12.3 contradiction arises.
budget_route.consequence: The repository computes no budget figure for this topic. Phase 8 stays hard-blocked until a validated response exists (CLAUDE.md §8.3, §13.4).

anonymity: Instance two is a demonstration and is never submitted. No coordinator, beneficiary or place is named in this binding. Consortium identity is pseudonymous and lives in docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/, authored by the consortium ticket.
authored_by: Tier 2B intake ticket, plans/dev_graph_demo_tickets.md, branch dev_graph_demo
notes: Call binding for instance two, the dev-graph demo. This file holds call-scoped facts only. Project-scoped facts — consortium, concept, duration, effort — are absent until their own tickets author them, and their absence is an honest gate failure rather than an assumption. The two findings the intake resolved against sources are recorded in docs/tier4_orchestration_state/decision_log/tier2b-biodiv-intake-dates_2026-09-29.json and tier2b-biodiv-intake-grant-type_2026-09-29.json.
